newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China '97 trade surplus seen at $17.4 bln.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China '97 trade surplus seen at $17.4 bln.

text.p: China's trade surplus is expected to expand to $17.4 billion in 1997, up from $12.24 billion last year, the China Business Times said on Friday.
Exports would increase by about 10 percent to $158.4 billion, while imports were expected to grow by 8.0 percent to $141 billion, the official newspaper said.
China reported a trade surplus of $12.24 billion on total record trade of $289.9 billion last year. That compared with a $16 billion surplus in 1995.
Foreign Trade Minister Wu Yi has said China's foreign trade volume was expected to reach $310 billion this year.
